# ADR-3068: A06: Unsigned package install for agent 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unsigned packages enable supply-chain swaps.

## Decision

Agents MUST NOT perform an unsigned package install for agent 8 (A06-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Signature verification is enforced.
